A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - pH 45 min

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for pH 45 min
data_PH45 <- read.csv("PH45.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_PH45$Mean <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Mean)
data_PH45$SD <- as.numeric(data_PH45$SD)
data_PH45$Sample <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Sample)
data_PH45$Age <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Age)
data_PH45$Weight <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Weight)
data_PH45$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Digestible_energy)
data_PH45$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Crude_protein)
data_PH45$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Crude_fat)
data_PH45$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Crude_fiber)
data_PH45$Ash <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Ash)
data_PH45$Lys <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Lys)
data_PH45$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Met_and_Cys)
data_PH45$Thr <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Thr)
data_PH45$Try <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Try)
data_PH45$Val <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Val)
data_PH45$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Dry_matter)
data_PH45$Ca <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Ca)
data_PH45$P <- as.numeric(data_PH45$P)
data_PH45$Na <- as.numeric(data_PH45$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_PH45$Position <- factor(data_PH45$Position)
data_PH45$Breed <- factor(data_PH45$Breed)
data_PH45$Class <- factor(data_PH45$Class)
data_PH45$Sex <- factor(data_PH45$Sex)
data_PH45$Region <- factor(data_PH45$Region) 
data_PH45$Aim <- factor(data_PH45$Aim)
data_PH45$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_PH45$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_PH45$rVar <- (data_PH45$SD/sqrt(data_PH45$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_PH45_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH45, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_PH45_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_PH45, method = "ML")
summary(null_PH45_mod) #-339.8579         
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1077; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  172.9289  3856.0954  -339.8579  -324.9121  -339.8355   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0158  0.1257   1077     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0399  0.1996    500     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1076) = 75764.6206, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se      zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   6.3128  0.0106  593.9770  <.0001  6.2920  6.3336  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_PH45_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_PH45, method = "ML")
summary(Re_PH45_mod) #-361.9961

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
PH45_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_PH45, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(PH45_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH45_full_mod,null_PH45_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval         QE 
## Full    318 -214.4201 1369.8352   53.2369 425.2100                 18808.6699 
## Reduced   3 -339.8579 -324.9121 -339.8355 172.9289 504.5622 <.0001 75764.6206
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
PH45_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Position,
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,
                           data = data_PH45, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(PH45_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH45_Position_mod,null_PH45_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval         QE 
## Full    22 -346.6570 -237.0544 -345.6969 195.3285                72442.8368 
## Reduced  3 -339.8579 -324.9121 -339.8355 172.9289 44.7991 0.0007 75764.6206
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
PH45_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Breed,

                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_PH45, method = "ML")
R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(PH45_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH45_Breed_mod,null_PH45_mod)

## Reduced   3 -339.8579 -324.9121 -339.8355 172.9289 300.7717 0.0060 75764.6206
## Model with Region as a fixed effect
PH45_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData,

                      sparse = TRUE,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(PH45_Region_mod)*100, 2)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
PH45_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData,

                       random = list(~1 |RowID,

                       sparse = TRUE,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(PH45_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(PH45_Class_mod,null_PH45_mod)
##

## Reduced  3 -339.8579 -324.9121 -339.8355 172.9289 18.1556 0.3791 75764.6206
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1], 
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_PH45_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,  
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      ~1 |Position), 
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_PH45, method = "REML")
summary(REML_PH45_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1077; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  196.1698  -392.3397  -380.3397  -350.4536  -380.2611   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0137  0.1172   1077     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0340  0.1844    500     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0076  0.0872     58     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.0017  0.0409    243     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  0.0052  0.0721     20     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 1076) = 75764.6206, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se      zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   6.3074  0.0308  204.9668  <.0001  6.2471  6.3677  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_PH45_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.67       22.02       54.47       12.17        2.69        8.32
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_PH45_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          77.91
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_PH45 <- orchard_plot(REML_PH45_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean pH 45 min", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_PH45)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_PH45_B3 <- data_PH45 %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_PH45_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH45_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,  
                               ~1 |Position) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_PH45_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_PH45_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int)

3.13 Dry matter

## Filter data for complete cases of Dry_matter
data_PH45_DM <- data_PH45[complete.cases(data_PH45$Dry_matter), ]
 
## Create VCV matrix for Dry matter data
VCV_PH45_DM_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_PH45_DM, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_PH45_DM <- data_PH45_DM %>%
  filter(!is.na(Dry_matter), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Dry_matter, na.rm = TRUE),
    DM_c   = Dry_matter - mu,
    DM_c2  = DM_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_PH45_DM_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_PH45_DM,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Region, ~1|Breed, ~1|Position)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH45_DM_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH45_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH45_DM_Data, mods = ~DM_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH45_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_PH45_DM_Data, mods = ~DM_c + DM_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_PH45_DM,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df logLik  AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           6 15.177 -15.6  0.00  0.759
## fit1     +      D_c  7 15.361 -13.0  2.66  0.201
## fit2     + D_c+D_c2  8 15.363  -9.8  5.88  0.040
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', D_c = '~DM_c', D_c+D_c2 = '~DM_c+DM_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df      AIC     BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     7 -16.7210 -5.2579 -12.9877 15.3605               275.9537 
## Reduced  6 -18.3538 -8.5283 -15.6441 15.1769 0.3672 0.5445 276.1967
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df      AIC     BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     8 -14.7264 -1.6257  -9.7609 15.3632               275.8848 
## Reduced  7 -16.7210 -5.2579 -12.9877 15.3605 0.0054 0.9413 275.9537
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]   # “fit0” / “fit1” / “fit2”
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Dry_matter, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Dry_matter = seq(min(df$Dry_matter), max(df$Dry_matter), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    DM_c = Dry_matter - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$DM_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["DM_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["DM_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Dry_matter, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Dry_matter, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Dry_matter, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Dry_matter, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Dry_matter = seq(min(df$Dry_matter), max(df$Dry_matter), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    DM_c  = Dry_matter - mu,
    DM_c2 = DM_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("DM_c","DM_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["DM_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["DM_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["DM_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Dry_matter, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Dry_matter, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Dry_matter, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Dry_matter)+.02*diff(range(df$Dry_matter)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Dry_matter = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Dry_matter)+.03*diff(range(df$Dry_matter)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Dry_matter (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_PH45_DM))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_PH45_DM))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_PH45_DM <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_PH45_DM)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value   AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear        1.66   0.546 -12.99       2.66               
## R2_marginal...2 Quadratic        1.65   0.942  -9.76       5.88               
## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA -15.64       0.00              ✔
## Display summary table for Dry Matter models

  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Thr, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Thr = seq(min(df$Thr), max(df$Thr), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Thr_c  = Thr - mu,
    Thr_c2 = Thr_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("Thr_c","Thr_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["Thr_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["Thr_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["Thr_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Thr, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Thr, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Thr, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Thr)+.02*diff(range(df$Thr)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Thr = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Thr)+.03*diff(range(df$Thr)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Thr (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_PH45_Thr))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_PH45_Thr))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_PH45_Thr <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_PH45_Thr)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_PH45)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 1077; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  196.0242  -392.0485  -378.0485  -343.1879  -377.9435   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0137  0.1172   1077     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0341  0.1847    500     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0076  0.0873     58     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.0017  0.0410    243     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.5  0.0052  0.0722     20     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 1075) = 68425.8198, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 1075) = 0.0064, p-val = 0.9365
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval    df    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub    
## intrcpt    6.8905  7.3114   0.9424  1075  0.3462  -7.4557  21.2366    
## Years     -0.0003  0.0036  -0.0797  1075  0.9365  -0.0074   0.0068    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          77.96
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH45 <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean pH 45 min", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH45 <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH45 + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_PH45)

## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:

## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.02          77.97
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_PH45_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_PH45)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_PH45 <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_PH45_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean pH 45 min", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_PH45)

4.3 Multiple_breeds (Whether multiple breeds were involved)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Mu <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed,
                            ~1 |Position)

#Model with intercept
Mu_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_PH45_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds,
   random = random_structure_Mu, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_PH45)
summary(Mu_VCV_REML_PH45_mod_int)
